He was fined 5k, then still didn't comply, but later fulfilled obligations. This is likely "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (refusal to execute judgment). Check if any other charges: He was fined 5k by court, but still didn't comply. That's criminal. No other crimes like fraud. So single charge.
